info.prompt: The Farkle Frenzy game board rendered as a cybernetic cathedral altar, with player avatars represented as geometric sigils floating above the grid, the tiles themselves being faceted gemstones in six distinct colors (gold, steel-blue, ruby, emerald, amethyst, onyx) that emit corresponding colored light beams when chained, stone blocker tiles appearing as cracked granite monoliths with glowing fracture lines, and a sweeping camera angle showing the entire board warping slightly as frenzy mode activates.
